pr_title: ESQL: create a Vector when needed for IN
pr_comment: Hi @astefan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: I think it's worth adding a test case that reproduces this one every time. And probably explaining why we want this statement rather than a link to the bug. It takes a bit of digging to reverse the sequence of events from the bug but it's fast to read a one liner like "no nulls, it's all true." Actually, do we only get here if everything is `true`? Maybe we should just return a constant block in that case?

Hehe, yeah I had that one liner but I discarded it and used the bug url. I've removed the url and added the one-liner. Regarding the test, you are right, I rushed it; I found a specific test that uncovers this.
